messages:
Jordan: Quick swing shift sync — leaving notes for the overnight team. TL;DR: canary failed on v2.4.1 deployment, partial rollback done, DB migration scheduled for 03:30 UTC, nothing user-facing yet but regen latency spike observed.

Maya: Thanks. Can you paste the canary failure logs and the rollback command you ran?

Jordan: Pasting the relevant bits: 
```
2026-03-16T22:14:08Z ERROR canary: inference-timeout model=redwood-v2.4.1 route=/chat latency=12000ms
2026-03-16T22:14:09Z WARN  kvcache: miss-rate up 18% over baseline
2026-03-16T22:14:10Z INFO  autoscaler: scaled-down pool=dedicated-gpu-12 replicas=2->1
```
Rollback command: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/redwood-runtime --to-revision=23 -n production`

Priya: Good call on rollback. Any signs it was model weights or the new kernel selection shim?

Jordan: Early signal points at the kernel selector fallback path. We added a new opt path in 2.4.1 that decides quantized-vk kernels for seq>2048; the canary used long contexts. Reproduced locally with a 3k token prompt and saw 10-12s tail latency.

Luis: Are there outstanding PRs touching the selector? @Maya — I recall you had one open last week.

Maya: Yep, PR #5123 tweaks the probe thresholds. I didn't expect it to trigger the legacy fallback, but the probe in canary env returned bad telemetry due to intermittent nvlink flakiness. I will revert the probe change and cut a hotfix.

Jordan: For overnight: 
- Action A: revert PR #5123 in canary & re-run canary once reverted (owner: Maya).
- Action B: watch regen latency dashboard and token p99 (owner: Priya). Alerts to keep an eye on: regen-latency-p99 (>3s) and canary-failure-rate (>2%).
- Action C: hold DB migration for model metadata until after canary test (scheduled 03:30 UTC) — postpone if canary still unstable (owner: Jordan).

Priya: I'll add two short watch tasks to the ops dashboard and pin escalation to oncall-escalate@redwood (if p99 > 5s for 10m).

Luis: Echo — if it flips again we should force canary to smaller context test (<=1024) to isolate. Also recommend toggling KV cache bypass for the canary route: `X-Feature-Flags: disable-kv-prefetch` for the test.

Jordan: Noted. Also left a quick runbook snippet in the repo under ops/runbooks/canary-failures.md with steps: 
1) snapshot canary logs to s3 `s3://redwood-ops/canary/$(date +%s).log`
2) run `kubectl rollout undo` if tail latency > 5s for 5 mins
3) if undo doesn't help, rollback to stable model variant `redwood-v2.3.9-compat`

Maya: Quick heads-up — I pushed a tiny patch to the autoscaler behavior yesterday that reduces aggressive downscaling. Might interact with the canary (we saw replicas drop 2->1). If we could keep minimum replicas=2 for canaries that would reduce flapping. PR #5140.

Jordan: Agreed. For now I've pinned the canary HPA minReplicas=2 manually. Will revert after morning.

Priya: Anything else on the list?

Jordan: Two small asks: 
- Please ping any pending PR reviews for the rollback hotfix (Maya) — I listed reviewers in the PR.
- If you get paged, follow the runbook; escalate to Luis if rollout undo fails or if the DB migration unexpectedly starts.

Luis: I'll be reachable on pager rotations. Added myself as emergency contact on the canary monitor.

sre-bot: Deploy bot: Canary deployment v2.4.1 -> rollback -> stable (rev 23) recorded. Incident marker created: INC-20260316-2271.

Maya: I'll cut the hotfix now and mark it urgent. ETA ~35m. Leaving detailed comment on PR with rollback trace. :construction_worker: 

Jordan: Thanks team. Leaving shift in good shape but keep an eye on p99 and the canary monitor. Signing off — Jordan (swing). :wave:
